spl_product_data_elements: Savvy Itch Stopping Diphenhydramine hydrochloride Zinc acetate CETYL ALCOHOL DIAZOLIDINYL UREA METHYLPARABEN PROPYLENE GLYCOL PROPYLPARABEN WATER POLYETHYLENE GLYCOL, UNSPECIFIED DIPHENHYDRAMINE HYDROCHLORIDE DIPHENHYDRAMINE ZINC ACETATE ZINC CATION
active_ingredient: Active Ingredient Diphenhydramine hydrochloride 2% Zinc acetate 0.1%
indications_and_usage: Uses ■ temporarily relieves pain and itching associated with ■ insect bites ■ minor burns ■ sunburn ■ minor skin irritations ■ minor cuts ■ scrapes ■ rashes due to poison ivy, poison oak, and poison sumac ■ dries the oozing and weeping of poison ivy, poison oak, and poison sumac
do_not_use: Do not use ■ on large areas of the body ■ with any other product containing diphenhydramine, even one taken by mouth Ask a doctor before use ■ on chicken pox ■ on measles
when_using: Ask a doctor before use avoid contact with eyes
stop_use: Stop use and ask a doctor if ■ condition worsens, or does not improve within 7 days ■ symptoms persist for more than 7 days or clear up and occur again wihin a few days
keep_out_of_reach_of_children: Keep out of reach of children If swallowed, get medical help or contact a Poison Control Center right away
dosage_and_administration: Directions ■ do not use more than directed ■ adults and children2 years of age and older: apply to affected area not more than 3 to 4 times daily ■ children under 2 years of age: ask a doctor
spl_unclassified_section: Other information ■ store at 20 to 25C (68-77F) ■ do not use if tube seal under cap is broken, missing or if the tube tip is cut prior to opening
inactive_ingredient: Inactive Ingredients cetyl alcohol, diazolidinyl urea, methylparaben, propylene glycol monostearate 1000, propylene glycol, propylparaben, purified water
